MJ Arsenal Turbine Mini Dab Rig

MJ Arsenal Turbine Mini Dab Rig INTRODUCTION

MJ Arsenal Turbine Mini Dab Rig is a desktop vaporizer designed for easy operation. You can use your favorite concentrate in this vape and enjoy. The unique turbine percolator system of the MJ Arsenal Turbine sends the terpene-flavored vapor with ease. It has a broad and sturdy base, which makes the MJ Arsenal Turbine Mini Dab Rig a portable dab rig for your leisure time at home. Just put it on your desk, prepare the wax with the tools in the package, and enjoy. You can also disassemble the dab rig and clean the different parts with ease.

Features

• Built with Borosilicate Glass

• Unique Turbine Percolator System

• Broad, Sturdy Base

• Transparent and Durable

MJ Arsenal Turbine Mini Dab Rig PACKAGE LIST

1 x MJ Arsenal Turbine Mini Dab Rig

1 x Mini Rig Standard Quart Bucket

1 x Flat Carb Cap

1 x Stainless Steel Mini Dab Tool

item.title: ZYN Espresso Martini Nicotine Pouches
item.description:
ZYN Espresso Martini Nicotine Pouches

ZYN Espresso Martini Nicotine Pouches INTRODUCTION

ZYN Espresso Martini Nicotine Pouches deliver a rich and robust coffee flavor. These pouches have a bitter and earthy coffee flavor. You will be enveloped in its creamy, smooth texture. Each can of ZYN Espresso Martini Nicotine Pouches contains up to 15 pouches for daily use. Each pouch lasts for at most 30 minutes. The smooth coffee flavor enters your mouth, allowing you to enjoy a relaxing experience no matter where you are. Multiple nicotine strengths are available for different preferences. You can enjoy your morning coffee with one ZYN Espresso Martini Nic Pouch.

Features

• Flavor: Espresso Martini

• Nicotine Avail: 3mg / 6mg

• Pure and Potent Nicotine

• Count: 15 Pouches

item.title: Ooze Pinch Dry Herb Vaporizer 1000mAh
item.description:
Ooze Pinch Dry Herb Vaporizer

Ooze Pinch Dry Herb Vaporizer INTRODUCTION

Ooze Pinch Dry Herb Vaporizer is a portable dry herb vaporizer designed by Ooze. It runs on a reliable 1000mAh built-in battery and only takes an hour for a full charge. Thanks to the special ceramic and hybrid heating, Ooze Pinch offers multiple heating modes. There are also 3 temperature levels available and each mode is displayed with a color. Different from 510 carts or dabs, Ooze Pinch Dry Herb Vaporizer focuses on flavor production and brings out the best terpene flavors and decent clouds.

Features

• Designed for Dry Herb: 0.3g Chamber Capacity

• Vegan Leather Finish

• Rechargeable 1000mAh Battery: 1h Charging

• Hybrid Heating: Special Ceramic for Multiple Heating Modes

• 3 Temperature Levels: 325°F (Green) / 375°F (Blue) / 425°F (Red)

• Strong Terpene-flavor Production

• Charging Port: Type-C (Cable Not Included)
